statement_summary: Security and Privacy Lead designated in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Vendor checklist, breach contact, and contract terms before sharing personal information; yearly SOC 2 or questionnaire for critical vendors
Annual independent control assessment
Security records kept 5 years
Annual policy review; policies available to all staff
Written, time-limited, risk-rated exceptions
Owner approves changes to payroll bank-change rules, admin rights, ATS roles, and AI settings
Unique accounts in every system; no shared logins
Least privilege table: payroll, onboarding packets, Form I-9, E-Verify, and background check results limited to two roles
MFA everywhere offered; authenticator app for payroll admins; MFA on MSP-held admin logins; number matching
No bank change by email or text; call-back to the number on file; first payroll after a change checked
Termination checklist on or before the last day, including E-Verify and MFA registrations
Monthly account reconciliation; quarterly access review
10-minute screen lock with no exemptions
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Passwords in the password manager; never written down; Wi-Fi password rotated
Firm systems for firm work; need-to-know only
Personal phone rules; no ID photos or SSNs on phones; lost phone reported within 1 hour
No personal email, personal cloud, or public AI chatbots for worker data
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Annual training, phishing simulations, payroll fraud training, E-Verify tutorial
regulatory_driver: E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.5; N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(g)(1)(iii))

statement_summary: Report suspected incidents at once, including own mistakes
Signed acknowledgment at hire and after each update
Runbook for payroll and HR system breach kept printed and current
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Incident log for every incident
Incident declaration criteria
Payroll freeze and deposit recall; associates made whole on payday
Insurer hotline before outside firms; MSP engaged
Breach determination time recorded; Florida 30-day clocks; no-harm determination rules
Immediate DHS notice if E-Verify data or credentials exposed
Notices follow the P08 matrix; counsel reviews
Vendor incident reports logged and handled; 10-day vendor duty
No extortion payment without Owner, counsel, insurer, and OFAC check
Annual tabletop with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three information levels; Restricted covers SSNs, bank data, Form I-9, E-Verify, consumer reports
Restricted data encrypted; candidates use the ATS upload link
Approved storage locations for Restricted data
Device and data inventory
New vendors and tools approved before receiving Restricted data
Approved AI tools only; no public chatbots for personal data
Paper is the only Form I-9 record; no scans; existing scans deleted after the paper check
Retention schedule for Forms I-9, consumer reports, payroll, applicants, and security records
Daily immutable backups with MFA; quarterly restore test; quarterly ATS export
Shredding and certified media wiping with records
